tagline: Zeiss Ikon折叠相机，1933 年发布
description: Zeiss Ikon于1933年推出的折叠相机。配备Nettar 1:7.7/10.5cm。快门速度** Nettar 1:6.3/7.5cm in a Derval or Telma leaf shutter。使用120 roll film (6×4,5cm exposures)。

specs.快门: ** Nettar 1:6.3/7.5cm in a Derval or Telma leaf shutter
specs.英文简介: The Nettar series by Zeiss Ikon was a successful range of self-erecting folding cameras for 120 roll film (often described as B2 6x9 film).
